title: cephalocarpus distichus
intro: Cephalocarpus distichus, commonly known as the "Bhui Amla" or "Wild Amla", is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cephalocarpus distichus include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight against infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
